title: Chelsea's Abramovich-era payments: the record fine
checked: UEFA €10m settlement (Jul 2023) for incomplete financial info: InsideWorldFootball + 90min. Premier League record £10.75m, 9-month academy ban, 1-year first-team ban suspended 2 years, payments 2011-2018, no points: Football365 + Deccan Herald (March 2026). FA 74 charges / 32 players (Express & Star), £10m fine + suspended 6 points replaced on appeal by a suspended two-window registration ban to 30 Jun 2027: 2 Hare Court + Reuters via Teleamazonas (31 Jul 2026). Chelsea quote from Football365.

lines.text: Chelsea got the biggest fine in Premier League history this year, for payments made under Roman Abramovich.
When the new owners bought the club in twenty twenty-two, they found problems in the old paperwork.
They reported it themselves, to the Premier League, the FA and UEFA.

scene.heading: Self-reported
scene.body: During the 2022 takeover, Chelsea's new owners told the Premier League, the FA and UEFA about historic financial issues.

lines.text: UEFA went first. July twenty twenty-three: a ten million euro settlement for incomplete financial information.
Then the Premier League. Between twenty eleven and twenty eighteen, it found undisclosed payments by people linked to the club, to players, unregistered agents and others.
March twenty twenty-six: a ten point seven five million pound fine. A Premier League record.
Plus a nine-month ban on signing some academy players, and a one-year transfer ban, suspended for two years.
But no points deduction. The league found Chelsea would never have broken the spending limit.
Chelsea accepted it, and said they were pleased the matter was concluded.

scene.heading: Chelsea's statement
scene.body: The club accepted both sanctions: "We are pleased that the matter is now concluded."

lines.text: Then the FA. Seventy-four charges over agent rules, involving thirty-two players.
In July, a ten million pound fine, and a six-point deduction, suspended.
On appeal, the points became a suspended two-window transfer ban. It hangs over Chelsea until June twenty twenty-seven.
